National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. It is closed right now (Thu 12 Nov, 7:50 PM), and opens again tomorrow, Fri 13 Nov, 10:00 AM.

Entry for adults is ₹20 and for foreign nationals ₹500. Students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card. Tickets can be booked at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum, and I have not booked anything.

This comes from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page. Check the holiday calendar on their site before you go.
